## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from SAGE/EAPP publisher pages and domain knowledge of European Association of Personality Psychology editorial culture. Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | Very High — EAPP European tradition |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium-High |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | European personality psychology — Big Five / HEXACO with European cross-cultural validation, personality process, dynamic personality (within-person variability), self-regulation, person-environment fit |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **personality research with European theoretical / methodological emphasis** — EAPP-affiliated; tradition values dynamic / process / within-person designs.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure US-style trait research without process emphasis redirected.

| Theoretical / Conceptual | 4 | EAPP welcomes theoretical |
| Mixed methods | 3 | Accepted |
| Meta-analysis | 4 | Welcomed |

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure US-style trait research without European framing
- AI use without disclosure per SAGE policy
- Pure qualitative without process emphasis

### Soft Tax

Low for EAPP-tradition / within-person designs.

### Best Suited For

- Within-person personality dynamics
- ESM / diary personality designs
- Self-regulation empirical work
- Person-environment fit research
- Cross-cultural personality validation
- European personality-process research

### Not Recommended For

- Pure US trait psychology (consider J Personality, PAID)
- Pure social psychology
- Pure qualitative

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Personality](./journal-of-personality.md) | Wiley peer; broader personality |
| 2 | [Journal of Research in Personality](./journal-of-research-in-personality.md) | Elsevier peer; ARP US-affiliated |
| 3 | [Personality and Individual Differences](./personality-and-individual-differences.md) | Elsevier peer; ISSID |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from J Personality as "too European / within-person," EJP is the SAGE EAPP-affiliated home.
